decisions.reason: As a long-established small chemical firm, it has relevant formulation and commercialization knowledge for facial care, and the product’s dedicated web presence in both 2023 and 2024 suggests positive learning and enough traction to continue.

A hyaluronic acid serum is close to the firm’s existing knowledge base and has remained on the website across both years, but its weaker presentation than Product A suggests only moderate confidence and some risk of later rationalization.

The cleansing oil is also closely related to the firm’s cosmetic-chemical capabilities, yet as a 2024 launch it has had less time for the firm to absorb market feedback and improve it, so uncertainty is higher though continuation is still more likely.
